result.summary:
TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR STEP 3b — REQ-193 — VERDICT: PASS.

All 9 behavioral acceptance criteria (AC1–AC9) have at least one runnable discriminating test. No AC is left to a stub, skip, or TODO.

AC1: Test decodes with Jason.decode!, splits on "\n" and asserts length==1, loops over all 5 required keys with Map.has_key?/2, and asserts message value. PASS.

AC2: DateTime.from_iso8601/1 for parseability PLUS independent regex ~r/T\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\.\d{6}Z$/ for microsecond digit count. Both assertions required independently. PASS.

AC3: Calls Context.assign_trace_id/1 on a real Plug.Test.conn (never sets Logger.metadata directly); reads conn.assigns.trace_id as expected; builds event from Logger.metadata() as set by assign_trace_id/1; asserts decoded trace_id == expected_trace_id. Has after Logger.reset_metadata(). PASS.

AC4: make_event with no trace_id key in meta; asserts Map.has_key?(decoded, "trace_id") AND decoded["trace_id"] == "". Presence and value independently checked. PASS.

AC5a: Source text check (assert runtime_exs =~ "Invalid LOG_LEVEL") PLUS assert_raise RuntimeError with message regex on the inline case expression. PASS.

AC5b: capture_log at :info refutes debug msg; capture_log at :debug asserts debug msg. try/after restores original level. PASS.

AC6: Two separate with_trace/1 collect calls; asserts id1a != "", id1a == id1b, id1a != id2a. All three necessary invariants covered. PASS.

AC7: Five keys tested — secret, password, token, client_secret, my_token (_token suffix). For each: Map.has_key? asserts key presence; decoded[key] == "[REDACTED]" asserts value. PASS.

AC8: Injects all four reserved keys into meta; asserts decoded["level"] == "info", decoded["message"] == "real message"; refutes decoded["component"] == "injected-component", refutes decoded["timestamp"] == "injected-timestamp". AC1 independently proves component and timestamp are always present, making the refute form sufficient. PASS.

AC9: File.read! on the actual source file; assert source =~ "field name". PASS.

Cross-cutting checks:
- No @tag :skip on any test.
- No 'TODO: implement test' in spec or test file.
- No hardcoded secrets or connection strings.
- Isolation: AC3 has after Logger.reset_metadata(); AC5b has try/after Logger.configure(level: original_level); all other tests use stateless make_event helper. No ordering dependency.
- Structure assertions use Jason.decode! throughout (not substring matching).
- async: false is justified and documented (AC5b mutates global log level).

WF-03 mutation note: This is WF-02, not WF-03. The mandatory mutant-apply requirement under WF-03's 'code did not exist pre-fix' clause does not apply.

ac_verdicts.AC1: PASS — single-line count + JSON decode + 5-key has_key? loop + message value assertion
ac_verdicts.AC3: PASS — real assign_trace_id/1 call, not direct Logger.metadata; Logger.reset_metadata() in after
ac_verdicts.AC4: PASS — presence (has_key?) and value (== "") both asserted
ac_verdicts.AC5a: PASS — source text check + assert_raise RuntimeError with message match
ac_verdicts.AC5b: PASS — two capture_log calls at different levels, try/after restores level
ac_verdicts.AC6: PASS — id1a != "", id1a == id1b, id1a != id2a all checked
ac_verdicts.AC7: PASS — all 5 patterns (secret, password, token, client_secret, _token suffix) with key-presence and [REDACTED] value checks
ac_verdicts.AC8: PASS — all 4 reserved fields injected; real values asserted, injected values refuted
ac_verdicts.AC9: PASS — File.read! source text assertion for 'field name'
